description: Checklist for Extension of Approval applications under AICTE regulations.

required_documents.name: Affidavit on Stamp Paper
required_documents.description: Notarized affidavit on stamp paper as per prescribed format by the governing body

required_documents.name: State Government NOC
required_documents.description: No Objection Certificate from the concerned State Government / UT Administration

required_documents.name: NBA / NAAC Accreditation Certificate
required_documents.description: Accreditation certificate from NBA or NAAC if applicable

required_documents.name: Fire Safety Certificate
required_documents.description: Valid fire safety certificate issued by the Chief Fire Officer of the district

required_documents.name: Land Ownership / Lease Document
required_documents.description: Registered land documents proving ownership or long-term lease (min 30 years)

required_documents.name: Approved Building Plan
required_documents.description: Building plan approved by the local municipal authority with completion / occupancy certificate

required_documents.name: Faculty Details and Approval List
required_documents.description: List of all approved faculty members with qualifications, Aadhaar, and appointment details

required_documents.name: Audited Financial Statement
required_documents.description: Audited statement of accounts for the previous financial year certified by a Chartered Accountant

required_documents.name: Previous Year EOA Certificate
required_documents.description: Extension of Approval letter / certificate for the preceding academic year

required_documents.name: Undertaking by Governing Body
required_documents.description: Undertaking by the Chairman / Secretary of the governing body on compliance

required_documents.name: AICTE Processing Fee Receipt
required_documents.description: Receipt of payment of processing fee to AICTE for the current application cycle

required_documents.name: Anti-Ragging Compliance Certificate
required_documents.description: Anti-ragging affidavit and compliance certificate as per UGC regulations

required_documents.name: Infrastructure Compliance Report
required_documents.description: Self-disclosure report on infrastructure, labs, library, and computing facilities

required_fields.description: Official name of the institution as registered with AICTE
Complete postal address of the institution
State or Union Territory where institution is located
List of AICTE-approved programmes with intake and level
Total approved student intake across all programmes
Number of approved full-time faculty members
Full name of the head of the institution
Name of the chairman of the institution's governing body
Name of the sponsoring trust or society
Academic year for which approval is sought (e.g. 2025-26)
Date of the previous year's Extension of Approval letter
Total campus land area in acres
Total built-up / carpet area available in square feet
Official contact email address of the institution

compliance_rules.description: Faculty to student ratio must not exceed 1:20
Minimum 2.5 acres of land for engineering colleges outside metropolitan cities
Minimum built-up area based on number of programmes and intake
Valid fire safety certificate from the Chief Fire Officer is mandatory
NBA accreditation is recommended for programmes older than 5 years
Minimum library collection of books and titles per programme
Minimum one computer for every 4 students
Institution must comply with UGC anti-ragging regulations
Institution must follow AICTE-approved fee refund policy
Campus must have ramps, elevators, and facilities for differently-abled persons
Institution must be registered on the All India Survey on Higher Education portal
Institution must publish mandatory disclosure on its official website
